sections.heading: In-Game Description
sections.text:
A passage describing a journey to enlightenment.
"For an age, I have been blessed by the worm. To be undying is to walk the eternal path to enlightenment, thus I must become enlightened to understand why I cannot die. It is said the holy dragon's origins were in the west. So I wonder, how did the worm come to be bestowed upon me?"

sections.heading: Overview
sections.text:
To be obtained early, Sekiro must first speak with the Faithful One on the bridge before the Ashina Castle Sculptor's Idol and reach the Main Hall of Senpou Temple, before questioning Isshin about the Mortal Blade.
Alternatively, reaching this item at the bottom of the lake requires killing the Corrupted Monk in Mibu Village and acquiring the Mibu Breathing Technique from her.
Required for the Return Ending.
